name: Export skins, joints, and inverse-bind matrices
description:
## Why
6/18 models have Skeleton + 305 Bones + JOINTS/WEIGHTS. Mesh is saved at bind pose; binding is dropped. Data is already in `model_file.bin` + `file.osgjs` — no extra fetch.

## Scope
`lib/osgjs2gltf.js`: JOINTS_0 / WEIGHTS_0, skins, skeleton, inverse-bind matrices from osgAnimation.Skeleton / Bone / RigGeometry. Needs the named node tree from the hierarchy leaf.

## Verification
A skinned sample GLB has skins + JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 and a skeleton. Bind-pose mesh still renders. `node --test`. Same-file as morphs — finish this before starting morphs.

## Plan
`.context/plans/recover-dropped-gltf-features.md` + `.context/FINDINGS.md`
result:
## Changed
RigGeometry exports glTF skins. Bones/Weights → JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0. BoneMap joint i maps to the Bone node of that name; JOINTS_0 stays osg indices into skins[].joints. InvBindMatrixInSkeletonSpace conjugated with the same R as node matrices. Skeleton node set on skin.skeleton.

## Files
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js`
- `test/skins.test.js`

## Verification
- `npm test`: 74 pass / 0 fail
- Synthetic 2-bone RigGeometry: skin, JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0, conjugated IBM
- Finger_on_a_board_Animated convert has skins + bind-pose POSITION
- Reviewer: PASS (fresh npm test 74/74)

## Risks
Incomplete BoneMap drops that skin (mesh still at bind pose). Shared SourceGeometry UniqueID could reuse the first BoneMap. Large rigs not converted in this leaf.

name: Keep morph targets instead of flattening
description:
## Why
5/18 models have MorphGeometry; we keep the base mesh and drop targets. Data is already in `model_file.bin`. Morph-weight clips come later with animations.

## Scope
`lib/osgjs2gltf.js`: emit glTF morph targets from osgAnimation.MorphGeometry instead of `extractMeshGeometry` flattening. Blocked by skinning because both rewrite the same walk/emit path.

## Verification
A morph sample GLB has extras/targets on the mesh; base still matches today’s look at weight 0. `node --test`.

## Plan
`.context/plans/recover-dropped-gltf-features.md` + `.context/FINDINGS.md`
result:
## Changed
MorphGeometry keeps MorphTargets. Base mesh still decoded via processGeometry (weight 0 matches flatten). Each target decoded the same way; glTF stores Y-up POSITION+NORMAL deltas. mesh.weights all 0; extras.targetNames from osg Name. Rig+Morph unwrap so skins and morphs can share a mesh.

## Files
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js`
- `test/morphs.test.js`

## Verification
- `npm test`: 77 pass / 0 fail
- Synthetic triangle: Y-up delta, flatten match
- Chainsaw convert: 7 targets, weights 0, no animations[]; deltas not absolute
- Reviewer: PASS (fresh npm test 77/77 + convert inspect)

## Risks
Targets needing parallelogram prediction use base strip indices. TANGENT morphs not emitted. Weights stay 0 until the animation leaf.

name: Emit real vertex colors as COLOR_0
description:
## Why
Blanket skip of osg `Color` in `processGeometry` drops the 3/18 models that have real COLOR_0. Most Sketchfab Color attrs are a constant engine tint (often pink + alpha≈0.5) that Blender multiplies against baseColorTexture.

## Scope
`lib/osgjs2gltf.js` only. Keep skip when the attribute is constant / tint-like; emit `COLOR_0` when there is real per-vertex variation. Do not invent cameras or LINES.

## Verification
Unit test the keep-vs-skip heuristic. Convert one of the 3 color samples from `.context/samples` and confirm COLOR_0 appears; a textured non-color model stays tint-free. `node --test`.

## Plan
`.context/plans/recover-dropped-gltf-features.md` + `.context/FINDINGS.md`
result:
## Changed
Conditional COLOR_0 export in `processGeometry`. Constant / near-constant engine tints (range ≤ 2/255 per channel, including pink+α≈0.5) stay skipped; real per-vertex RGB/RGBA becomes `COLOR_0`.

## Files
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` — `shouldKeepVertexColors`, `color0FromOsgAttr`
- `test/vertex-colors.test.js` — keep-vs-skip + processGeometry + Battle-Scarred convert

## Verification
- `npm test`: 69 pass / 0 fail
- `node --test test/vertex-colors.test.js`: 8 new tests pass
- Battle-Scarred soldier GLB (has bin, no Color) has no COLOR_0
- Fall_and_Rise osgjs declares Color; keep path proven with synthetic decoded data (sample has no `model_file.bin`)

## Risks
No real COLOR_0 GLB from a color sample (those dirs lack bins). Quiet gradients below ~2/255 still treated as tint. `processGeometry` is now exported for tests.

name: Fix review C1/M1/M2: ArrayBuffer over sendMessage -> 0-byte file; fallback race; badge 0
description:
Review found real bugs in the #3 fallback (background.js + offscreen/offscreen.js). Own those two files only.
- C1 (CRITICAL): offscreen refetchBytes returns an ArrayBuffer via sendResponse; Chrome serializes runtime messages as JSON (NOT structured clone), so it arrives as {} -> new Uint8Array({}) len 0 -> empty base64 -> data URL downloads a 0-byte file silently. FIX: encode in offscreen (which holds the bytes) to a JSON-safe STRING before sending — base64 the bytes there (chunked, 32768) and send {ok,base64,mime}; in background build data URL directly as data:<mime>;base64,<string> (no ArrayBuffer, no re-encode). A plain string always survives runtime messaging.
- M1 (minor): onChanged->interrupted fallback re-entrancy: before the retry download in the async offscreen callback, guard that the job is still live (jobs.has(uid) and phase still 'saving') to avoid a phantom download after a duplicate interrupted event advanced the queue.
- M2 (minor): badge shows '0' for queued jobs (updateBadge rounds pct=0). Make it not show '0' (e.g. show active-job count, or empty until pct>0).
result: Fixed C1 0-byte data-URL fallback (base64 string over messaging), M1 fallback re-entrancy guard, M2 badge no longer shows 0

commit.message: Fix data-URL fallback 0-byte file, re-entrancy, and badge "0"

name: lib CRC32 dedup + reconsider PNG decode order (#10, #8)
description:
Owns lib/descramble.js, lib/zip.js, new lib/crc32.js. See plan Task 3.
- #10 (minor): extract ONE shared lib/crc32.js exporting the offset form crc32(u8,start,len). zip.js + descramble.js import it. zip.js's whole-buffer callers -> crc32(data,0,data.length). test/zip.test.js imports crc32 from zip.js -> keep zip.js re-exporting (or update test import). npm test must stay green.
- #8 (important, RECONSIDER/likely defer): current 'custom PNG parser first' order (decodeToRgba, descramble.js:536) is a CORRECTNESS choice — decodeViaBitmap round-trips createImageBitmap->canvas (lossy premultiply/color-mgmt, corrupts ORM/normal maps). npm test CANNOT catch a regression (Node lacks ImageDecoder/createImageBitmap). If pursued: prefer ImageDecoder ONLY (exact copyTo RGBA), never move canvas path ahead of custom parser; requires manual browser pixel comparison. Otherwise return 'no change, premise did not hold'.
Verify: npm test (zip/descramble/orm) green.
result: Extracted shared lib/crc32.js (offset-capable crc32); zip.js re-exports whole-buffer wrapper, descramble.js imports it; #8 PNG decode order left unchanged (correctness-motivated, unverifiable in Node)

name: Fix review I1: panel.js navigate event fires pre-commit -> SPA re-sync broken
description:
Review found #4 regression in content/panel.js. Own that file only.
- I1 (IMPORTANT): the 'navigate' event fires BEFORE navigation commits, so location.href is still the old URL inside the handler and onNav's (location.href===lastHref) guard blocks the re-sync -> button never updates on SPA model-to-model nav. FIX: listen for 'navigatesuccess' instead of 'navigate' (fires post-commit, URL updated), OR read event.destination.url in the handler. Keep the feature-detect + else-branch setInterval poll fallback intact.
result: Listen for Navigation API navigatesuccess (post-commit URL) instead of navigate so the button re-syncs on SPA model-to-model navigation

commit.message: Re-sync button on SPA nav via navigatesuccess

name: Emit named node hierarchy instead of baking
description:
## Why
We flatten 6180 osg.MatrixTransform / osg.Node matrices into vertices. Skins and morphs need a real node tree. Static models must keep the same world placement (Y-up flip stays correct).

## Scope
`lib/osgjs2gltf.js`: `collectGeometries` walk + emit. Named nodes + TRS; stop `applyMatrixToVertices` for placement once nodes carry the transform. Keep current mesh/PBR/UV behavior. Same file as colors — do not start in parallel with that leaf.

## Verification
Static samples (BulkHead_Door, Iveco truck, Etalon) look unchanged. Named nodes present. Existing `test/transform.test.js` + `node --test` still pass. This is the prereq artifact for skinning and morphs.

## Plan
`.context/plans/recover-dropped-gltf-features.md` + `.context/FINDINGS.md`
result:
## Changed
Named glTF node graph replaces placement baking. `osg.MatrixTransform` / `osg.Node` / Bone / Skeleton emit named nodes; local mesh verts stay local; node matrices conjugated `M' = R M R⁻¹` so composed world matches the old bake+Y-up path.

## Files
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` — `conjugateZupToYup`, graph walk, `buildGLTF` wires `options.graph`
- `test/hierarchy.test.js` — nested MT world-match + Battle-Scarred tree

## Verification
- `npm test`: 72 pass / 0 fail
- Nested translations: local POSITION, world within 1e-5 of bake+Y-up
- Battle-Scarred convert is a named node tree, not a flat mesh soup
- Reviewer: PASS (fresh `npm test` 72/72)

## Risks
Rig/Morph meshes now inherit parent node matrices (old path used `worldMatrix = null`). Inverse-bind matrices on the skin leaf must use the same conjugate `R`. Extra Skeleton/Node wrappers are not joints.

name: Recover dropped osgjs → GLB features
description:
# Recover dropped osgjs → GLB features

Inventory and counts: `.context/FINDINGS.md` (18 sample models).

We already export meshes (positions, normals, tangents, all UV sets, triangles + strips) and full PBR materials. This plan recovers the glTF-representable data we currently drop. Do not add cameras (none in osgjs) or wireframe `LINES` (viewer-regenerated helpers).

## Constraint

Geometry, skin weights, vertex colors, morph targets, hierarchy, and lights all live in files we already download (`model_file.bin` + `file.osgjs`). Animation **keyframes** live in separate `<hash>.bin.gz` files the pipeline never fetches — that is the only network-scope change.

## Build order

1. **Vertex colors** — stop the blanket `Color` skip in `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` (`processGeometry`). Emit `COLOR_0` only when the attribute is real variation, not a constant engine tint. 3/18 models. No extra download.
2. **Node hierarchy** — emit named glTF nodes + TRS instead of baking 6180 `osg.MatrixTransform` / `osg.Node` matrices into vertices (`collectGeometries` walk + `applyMatrixToVertices`). Prerequisite for skins and morphs. Keep Y-up conversion correct.
3. **Skinning** — 6/18 models: `JOINTS_0` / `WEIGHTS_0` from Bones/Weights attrs, plus `skins`, skeleton, inverse-bind matrices from `osgAnimation.Skeleton` / `Bone`. Data already in `model_file.bin` + osgjs. Bind-pose mesh is already saved.
4. **Morph targets** — 5/18 models: keep `osgAnimation.MorphGeometry` targets instead of flattening to the base mesh. Data already in `model_file.bin`.
5. **Lights** — optional, low value (`KHR_lights_punctual`; look like default directionals). Skip unless leftover after 1–4.
6. **Animations** — the large leaf. Discover + download `<hash>.bin.gz`, gunzip, decode `Float32` and `CompressedPacked` (varint + quantized Uint16) channels, emit named `animations[]` (18 clips today, 15/18 models). Do last. Needs hierarchy (and skins/morphs if those channels target them).

## Primary files

- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js` — converter (all features)
- `lib/pipeline.js` — extra fetch only for animations
- `lib/sf-api.js` / `lib/decrypt.js` — only if anim bin URLs need discovery/decrypt
- `test/*.test.js` — fold verification into the leaf that changes the behavior (`node --test`)
- Samples: `.context/samples/*/file.osgjs` + `model_file.bin`

## Done when

A GLB from a skinned/morphed/animated sample keeps: vertex colors when real, a named node tree (not a baked soup), skins + morph targets, and named animation clips. Static-only models (BulkHead_Door, Iveco truck, Etalon) stay visually unchanged. Existing mesh/PBR/UV tests still pass.
result:
## Changed
Recovered dropped glTF features from osgjs: COLOR_0 (tint heuristic), named Y-up node graph (no placement bake), skins + conjugated IBM, morph POSITION/NORMAL deltas at weight 0, and named animations[] via gzip `<hash>.bin.gz` fetch + Float32/CompressedPacked decode.

## Files
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js`, `lib/pipeline.js`
- `test/{vertex-colors,hierarchy,skins,morphs,animations}.test.js`

## Verification
- `npm test`: 86 pass / 0 fail (parent re-run after review fixes)
- Per-leaf reviewers: all PASS
- Manifest review: no Critical; Important follow-ups applied (no min/max on MAT4 IBM; animation-bin failures logged as WARNING)

## Risks
Packed-quat untested on live `.bin.gz`. Skinned rest pose under non-identity mesh parents. Lights skipped (low value). Samples have no keyframe bins on disk. DEBUG_SAVE_OSGJS still packages a debug ZIP.

name: Fetch, decode, and export animation clips
description:
## Why
18 named clips (15/18 models) are the largest drop. glTF supports multiple named animations. Keyframes are NOT in files we already download.

## Scope
1) Discover + download `<hash>.bin.gz` in `lib/pipeline.js` (and `sf-api.js` / `decrypt.js` only if URLs need it). 2) Gunzip. 3) Decode Float32 and CompressedPacked (varint + quantized Uint16) channels. 4) Emit `animations[]` targeting the node / skin / morph objects from earlier leaves. Do not do this before hierarchy + skin + morph exist.

## Verification
A multi-clip sample (snakes: 3 clips, SCOUT: 2) exports named animations with channels. Static-only models unchanged and fetch no extra bins. `node --test` plus one converted animated sample.

## Plan
`.context/plans/recover-dropped-gltf-features.md` + `.context/FINDINGS.md`
result:
## Changed
Named clips convert end-to-end. Pipeline collects unique `<hash>.bin.gz` next to `file.binz`, fetches gzip (not binz), gunzips into fileMap. Converter decodes Float32 + CompressedPacked Vec3 (`o+b+q*h`) and packed quats (best-effort), emits `gltf.animations[]` with Y-up remapped TRS and morph weights. Static models fetch nothing.

## Files
- `lib/osgjs2gltf.js`
- `lib/pipeline.js`
- `test/animations.test.js`

## Verification
- `npm test`: 86 pass / 0 fail
- Synthetic fileMap emits named animations + weights path
- Static convert / BulkHead: no extra URLs, no animations[]
- Reviewer: PASS (fresh npm test 86/86)

## Risks
Packed quat untested against live `.bin.gz`. `channel_mode` / `ot` unused. Missing bins skip silently (samples have no keyframe files on disk).
